about: Mod ping-pong round 5, batch 7 (docs/design/mod-pingpong.md#lote-7--create-aeronautics-a-prueba): Create Aeronautics on trial (Elias, 27 September): its own batch, its cost measured against batches 1-6, kept only if the cost is acceptable. The bundled jar carries Aeronautics, Create Simulated and Offroad; Sable is their physics library (Rapier natives, Veil). FTB Chunks: Sable Aerospace makes FTB Chunks claims apply to Sable structures. Staging by the pingpong5aero family of tools/generate_family_balance.py.

aeronautics_bundled: Physics airships: propellers, hot-air envelopes and burners, levitite, gyroscopic bearings; Create Simulated (physics assembler, swivel bearings, ropes, sensors, docking) and Offroad (wheels and tunnel borers)
The physics assembler turns a build into a physics structure: the handling core fills its free top slot (Act III), like the gyrodyne of Immersive Aircraft

qol.ftbchunksaerospace: Clicks and block breaking on a Sable structure follow the FTB Chunks claim it is in, so a ship parked in a claim is protected like the claim
